label: Custom collection (Sync Gateway database config)
type: a non-default Couchbase Server collection mapped into a Sync Gateway database config - must already exist on the Server bucket (Sync Gateway never creates one). Available since Couchbase Lite 3.1 / Sync Gateway 3.1; a pre-3.1 Sync Gateway or Capella App Services deployment must use server:default-collection instead.
note: Cluster-wide cap stated as 1000 by configuration-schema-database.md, but scopes-and-collections-config.md states the identical number 'per database' - a real, unreconciled discrepancy, filed as a docs-issue.
